title: Route-level latency labyrinth: diagnostic dashboard and instrumentation for token-phase decomposition
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Build a diagnostic dashboard and the minimal tracing/metric plumbing required to attribute end-to-end route latency into token-phase slices and streaming vs non-streaming cohorts. Goal is to make regressions actionable: identify whether slowdowns are in prefix pre-processing, KV cache lookup, kernel dispatch, model execution, or streaming chunking. This ticket covers the dashboard spec, required instrumentation spans/metrics, pipeline schema for enriched metrics/logs, sampling policy, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for total request latency and for three token-phase buckets: prefix_processing, generation_exec, and stream_emit
Dashboard can filter/cohort by model_family, model_variant, route, io_mode (streaming | non-streaming), request_seq_len, and batch_size
Tracing hooks added for serve.accept, prefix.prepare, kv.cache_lookup (tag cache_hit=true|false), kernel.selection, infer.dispatch, and stream.chunk_emit
Metric/enriched log schema includes request_id, trace_id, route, model_variant, io_mode, seq_len, batch_size, cache_hit, kernel_type, and server_region
Metrics and traces are discoverable in the staging observability stack (OTel -> Tempo/Jaeger + Prometheus remote_write -> ClickHouse) for at least a 24h window
Dashboard includes automated cohort comparison view: streaming vs non-streaming for same route and model, highlighting percentiles and absolute regression deltas
A rollout playbook is documented with safe flags and a controlled sampling ramp to 10%/25%/100%
PRs with instrumentation have at least two code reviews and one trace sampling smoke test that demonstrates expected span timing decomposition

implementation_notes: Instrumentation: add lightweight spans with duration-only timing and tags for cache_hit and kernel_type. Avoid adding heavy logs per token. Metrics: emit per-request histograms for token_phase durations (prefix_ms, generation_ms, emit_ms) and one boolean gauge for kv_cache_hit. Sampling: use dynamic sampler keyed by route and model_family; start at 5% for all, automatic bump to 25% for routes flagged as degraded. Pipeline: otel-collector attributes_to_metrics -> prometheus remote_write -> clickhouse; traces -> tempo. Ensure retention policy of 7d for traces and 30d for aggregated metrics.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: high cardinality from free-form tags (e.g., model_variant long ids). Mitigation: normalize model_variant to family+short-id and truncate long IDs in the collector. Risk: TSDB volume increase. Mitigation: staged sampling ramp and histogram bucketing at exporter side. Risk: incorrect attribution when fallback routing occurs. Mitigation: span-tag fallback=true and ensure trace continuity across handoffs.
